management_major_statements.value: Management stated that Hyundai sold 4.14 million vehicles globally in 2025, recorded a record KRW 186.3 trillion of revenue, KRW 11.47 trillion of operating income, a 6.2% operating margin, and KRW 10.36 trillion of net income amid global trade uncertainty and tariff pressure.

For H1 2026, the company states that its vehicle segment sold about 1.97 million units and generated about KRW 71 trillion of consolidated vehicle-segment revenue, and that it will respond to market uncertainty through Manufacturing Excellence, New Product Innovation, Advanced Tech & SDV, and Investing for the Future & Innovative Partnerships.
management_major_statements.original_location: DART PDF p.29, vehicle segment overview

management_major_statements.value: The company identifies global scale, diversified powertrains and product portfolio, localized value chains, and group-company synergies as four core competitive capabilities supporting its 2030 strategy.

important_changes.value: H1 revenue: KRW 95,154,214 million in 2026 versus KRW 92,694,438 million in 2025; H1 operating income: KRW 5,365,574 million versus KRW 7,235,206 million; H1 consolidated net income: KRW 5,472,888 million versus KRW 6,632,564 million.

important_changes.value: Q2 revenue: KRW 49,215,328 million in 2026 versus KRW 48,286,677 million in 2025; Q2 operating income: KRW 2,850,888 million versus KRW 3,601,597 million; Q2 consolidated net income: KRW 2,887,962 million versus KRW 3,250,390 million.
important_changes.original_location: DART PDF p.68 consolidated income statement

important_changes.value: FY2025 vehicle-segment revenue increased 6.5% year over year to KRW 145.632 trillion; vehicle-segment operating income decreased 25.8% to KRW 8.471 trillion. The filing attributes the operating-income decline to North American tariff effects and increased incentives.
important_changes.original_location: DART PDF p.413-415, MD&A segment discussion

important_changes.value: FY2025 finance-segment revenue increased 6.3% year over year to KRW 30.233 trillion and operating income increased 20.5% to KRW 2.164 trillion, as stated by the company.
important_changes.original_location: DART PDF p.413-415, MD&A segment discussion

important_changes.value: Consolidated cash and cash equivalents were KRW 20,256,150 million at June 30, 2026 versus KRW 18,360,566 million at December 31, 2025; borrowings and bonds carrying amount was KRW 188,805,180 million versus KRW 175,389,838 million.

risk_related_disclosures.value: The H1 2026 filing states that Hyundai Motor and consolidated entities continue to be defendants in domestic and overseas lawsuits, including product-liability matters, and continue to be investigated by domestic and overseas authorities regarding Theta II engine recalls; outcomes and effects cannot be predicted.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: DART PDF p.154 and investor-protection section pp.365-367
risk_related_disclosures.note: The same Theta II recall / investigation disclosure is present in the supplied FY2025 Business Report.

risk_related_disclosures.value: A new Hyundai Rotem proceeding disclosed in the H1 2026 report was filed on June 25, 2026 against the legal administrator of STX in rehabilitation. The primary claim amount is KRW 55,612 million and the alternative claim amount is KRW 79,446 million. The filing states that if Hyundai Rotem loses, approximately KRW 28.3 billion of prepaid amounts would have to be returned to STX, and the probability of loss cannot currently be reasonably predicted.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: DART PDF pp.366-368, Hyundai Rotem significant litigation

risk_related_disclosures.value: As of June 30, 2026 the consolidated group had a KRW 3,349,350 million commitment to contribute capital through 2030 to related party HMG Future Complex Co., Ltd. for a new research and office hub.
risk_related_disclosures.original_location: DART PDF Note 36 / investor-protection section, commitment disclosure
risk_related_disclosures.new_vs_fy2025: not located in the supplied FY2025 report under the same disclosure wording

risk_related_disclosures.value: The company continues to identify tariff and trade-policy uncertainty as an operating risk, including U.S. import vehicle/parts tariffs. HMGMA localization and added U.S. production capacity are described as measures intended in part to minimize tariff impact.
